expiration_days.description: Delete objects this many days after creation, via a scaleway_object_bucket lifecycle_rule expiration. null (the default) adds no expiration rule at all. Day-granular only -- the S3 lifecycle API this wraps has no finer unit, so a 72-hour retention is expressed as 3. Note this is independent of storage_class's own 90-day glacier transition: an expiration shorter than 90 days means objects are deleted before that transition could ever fire, so pair a short expiration with storage_class = "standard".
